Schedule 5.1 [en. B.C. Reg. 135/2017, App. 1, s. 2.] No Shooting Areas — Specified Crown Land (Section 7.1)
Hatzic
9 Those portions of M.U. 2-8, in the vicinity of the District of Mission, being all Crown land within 400 m of the midline of the portions highlighted in red of the roads on Map No. 5.1-1/17 in Schedule 15.
